pages.text: Find Silver, Amethyst, Garnet, Opal and Salt in newly generated eligible Overworld chunks. Silver needs a stone pickaxe; gems need iron. Salt can be mined with a wooden pickaxe.

Smelt Silver Ore into ingots. Gems support Fortune and Silk Touch. Nine matching resources form a storage block and can be unpacked. Cold Iron comes from iron ore exposed to Frostfire; Perpetual Ice is available from Iceworld brews.
